addition.item: Navigation Dropdown Menu element with Joomla menu or custom manual items and nested submenu children
Responsive mobile menu toggle, hover/click submenu trigger and DevArt color themes
Data Feature Blocks element with configurable columns, per-item DevArt themes and Font Awesome icon picker
Full-width block row layout with subtitle, title and read-more underline link

change.item: Copyright and Branding color theme now styles accent, text and links instead of background tint only
Copyright and Branding add Background option: None or Theme color

fix.item: Feature Blocks theme backgrounds use visible DevArt pastel tints (red, orange, blue, green, yellow, purple, gray, dark)

note.item: Recommended update for all DevArt Elements installations
Always test updates on a staging environment before production deployment

fix.item: Clean install now creates the elements table: install/uninstall SQL use charset="utf8" as required by the Joomla installer (utf8mb4 previously caused SQL files to be skipped)
Schema update 1.1.1.sql recreates the full elements table with CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS for sites that installed 1.1.0 without the table

note.item: Recommended update for all DevArt Elements 1.1.0 installations, especially clean installs that reported a missing devartelements_elements table
Always test updates on a staging environment before production deployment

addition.item: Fifteen locales for administrator, module and package (en-GB and el-GR curated; fr-FR, de-DE, es-ES, it-IT, pt-BR, cs-CZ, nl-NL, pl-PL, ru-RU, uk-UA, ja-JP, tr-TR, zh-CN)
Administrator hub dashboard for Content Blocks, Navigation, Data, Media, Pricing and Tools with Options and Modules shortcuts
Lightweight ArticleSelect picker for large article sites (replaces slow Joomla modal_article)
Module output cache clearing after element save and import
Shared language keys for administrator forms and frontend Read more / Open page / media controls

change.item: First public release after 1.0.1 (intermediate private builds 1.0.2–1.0.12 were not published separately; their changes are included here)
ElementFamilyHelper consolidated: component is the single source of truth; module uses a thin site facade
Module configuration uses only the unified element_id selector (legacy per-type hidden fields removed)
Accordion titles wrap responsively on desktop and mobile

fix.item: Import HTML sanitization for stored XSS in content_json
Upload validation with is_uploaded_file() on import preview
Strict JSON encode/decode in ElementModel with user-facing errors
ElementTable title requirement and unique type+alias validation
URL filter="url" on administrator URL fields
Schema checker false positive from non-Joomla IF NOT EXISTS SQL syntax

security.item: Import path sanitizes non-URL strings in content_json via Joomla InputFilter
Rejects non-upload file paths during import preview

note.item: Public release replacing the previous public line at 1.0.1
Recommended update for all DevArt Elements installations
Always test updates on a staging environment before production deployment

addition.item: Initial public package of DevArt Elements for Joomla 6
Component com_devartelements for reusable content elements
Site module mod_devartelements for frontend rendering
